# Getting help

Read the [task guides](../docs/README.md) for setup, configuration, operation and recovery. For a reproducible engine bug or improvement, use the [existing issue templates](https://github.com/Lenivvenil/digest/issues/new/choose); search existing issues first.

Include the immutable engine commit, Python version, command, expected result and a minimal synthetic reproduction. Remove credentials, recipient identifiers, private source configuration, model responses and runtime state. Share only the smallest non-sensitive error excerpt needed to explain the problem.

For suspected vulnerabilities, follow [security reporting guidance](SECURITY.md) before posting. Public issues are not a confidential channel. There is no guaranteed response time or commercial support commitment. Existing [upgrade and retained-state guidance](../docs/OPERATIONS.md#upgrades-and-retained-state) governs pin changes and recovery.
